what: The title letters start faintly in the line color. From when the title top reaches 90% of the screen until its center reaches 40%, they are tied to scroll (scrub .1): letters flash in the accent color one at a time from the front (.12s power2.out) and settle into their own text color (.28s power2.in). Scrolling back returns passed letters to the line color in .2s. Progress is rounded to a letter count and only changed letters are touched, so scrolling fast makes the flashes pass in a row.

options.start · end: ScrollTrigger start·end, default top 90% · center 40% — the hero title is top bottom · top 98% (all at once on open)
options.wave: Length of one flash cycle (s), default .4 — flash 30% · settle 70% · return 50%
options.--fx-from · --fx-flash: Laid text color · flash color, default --kf-line · --kf-accent. The settled color is the element’s text color

use: Large title
note: Split words·characters with SplitText (words do not wrap), and re-apply when a late font load causes a re-split. With reduced motion nothing is applied, so the text keeps its own color

from.where: Large titles of index.html·about.html·list.html·cities.html — original GradientWaveText (data-gradient-wave-text, --border → --canada → text color)
